claims.natural_statement: For the dyadic operator with weight abs(Q)^p, p>0, spectral exponent beta>max(0,p-1) yields an exact weighted affine probability law by the resolvent eigenmeasure, horizontal-period cancellation, and logarithmic scale averaging.

For p>0 and beta>=0, an exact weighted affine law gives almost-sure finiteness of integral over S0 of y^(beta+p-1) abs(F)^(-p-2), and compact positive superlevels of y^k/abs(F-xi) for almost every target, where k=(beta+p+1)/(p+2)>1/2.

Under the exact affine law with p>0 and beta>=0, generic regular targets have distinct critical values, the superlevel index count gives at least as many finite maxima as saddles above every positive level, and rank pairing is Borel, fiberwise injective, strictly height-increasing, and affine equivariant.

For every exact affine law with p>0 and beta>=0, k=(beta+p+1)/(p+2), the signed-Jacobian comparison is E[J(i)]<=0, with equality only if J is identically zero almost surely. The proof includes bad targets at the normalized root and the unbounded strict gain without a uniform gap.
For k>0 and normalized univalent F on H, J_F identically zero is possible only at k=1; then F is either z-i or F_t(z)=((z-t)^2-(i-t)^2)/(2(i-t)) for a unique real t.

The normalized quadratics F_t, t real, sampled with density dt/(pi*(1+t^2)), satisfy the exact inverse-square affine law with beta=1 for every nonnegative Borel test. This is the unique such law supported on the affine map and normalized quadratics.

Among all Borel probability laws on normalized univalent half-plane maps satisfying the inverse-square affine covariance with beta>=1, the only law is beta=1 and the Cauchy-distributed normalized quadratic family F_t. In particular no beta>1 law exists.

The abstract finite-cutoff exhaustion comparison, strict integrable-gain equality argument without a uniform gap, two moment-identity endpoint reductions, and admissibility/injectivity of every real-vertex normalized quadratic hold exactly as encoded in Main.lean and described in statement_fidelity.md; this is not the full analytic classification theorem.

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory

namespace AffineTransport

theorem le_of_small_error (a d : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → a ≤ d + ε) : a ≤ d := by
  by_contra hn
  have hg : 0 < (a - d) / 2 := by linarith
  have hh := h ((a - d) / 2) hg
  linarith

theorem exhausted_comparison (a : ℕ → ℝ) (b d : ℝ)
    (hfinite : ∀ n ε, 0 < ε → a n ≤ d + ε)
    (hexhaust : ∀ ε, 0 < ε → ∃ n, b ≤ a n + ε) : b ≤ d := by
  apply le_of_small_error
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hexhaust (ε / 2) (by linarith)
  have hf := hfinite n (ε / 2) (by linarith)
  linarith

theorem box_factor_bound (h v ε : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hhε : h ≤ ε / 4) (hvε : v ≤ ε / 4) :
    (1 + h) * (1 + v) ≤ 1 + ε := by
  have hm := mul_le_mul hhε hvε hv (by linarith : 0 ≤ ε / 4)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1)]

theorem strict_gain_forces_zero
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (pos neg gain : Ω → ℝ)
    (ipos : Integrable pos μ) (ineg : Integrable neg μ)
    (igain : Integrable gain μ)
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ pos ω)
    (hneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ neg ω)
    (hle : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, pos ω ≤ gain ω)
    (hstrict : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 < pos ω → pos ω < gain ω)
    (htransport : (∫ ω, gain ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, neg ω ∂μ)
    (hbalance : (∫ ω, pos ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, neg ω ∂μ) :
    (pos =ᵐ[μ] 0) ∧ (neg =ᵐ[μ] 0) := by
  have hmono := integral_mono_ae ipos igain hle
  have heq : (∫ ω, pos ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, gain ω ∂μ := by linarith
  have hpg : pos =ᵐ[μ] gain :=
    (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le ipos igain hle).mp heq
  have hz : pos =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hpos, hstrict, hpg] with ω hp hs he
    change pos ω = 0
    by_contra hn
    have hp0 : 0 < pos ω := lt_of_le_of_ne hp (Ne.symm hn)
    have hh := hs hp0
    linarith
  have hpint : (∫ ω, pos ω ∂μ) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∫ ω, pos ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, (0 : Ω → ℝ) ω ∂μ := integral_congr_ae hz
      _ = 0 := by simp
  have hnint : (∫ ω, neg ω ∂μ) = 0 := by linarith
  exact ⟨hz, (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hneg ineg).mp hnint⟩

theorem inverse_square_endpoint (β j : ℝ)
    (hβ : 1 ≤ β) (hj : j ≤ 0)
    (hmoment : ((β + 3) / 4) ^ 2 * j = (β + 3) * (β - 1) / 16) :
    β = 1 := by
  have hleft : ((β + 3) / 4) ^ 2 * j ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg _) hj
  by_contra hn
  have hβ1 : 1 < β := lt_of_le_of_ne hβ (Ne.symm hn)
  have hright : 0 < (β + 3) * (β - 1) / 16 :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num)
  linarith

theorem inverse_first_endpoint (β j : ℝ)
    (hβ : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ β) (hj : j ≤ 0)
    (hmoment : ((β + 2) / 3) ^ 2 * j = (4 * β - 1) * (β + 2) / 9) :
    β = (1 : ℝ) / 4 := by
  have hleft : ((β + 2) / 3) ^ 2 * j ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg _) hj
  by_contra hn
  have hβ1 : (1 : ℝ) / 4 < β := lt_of_le_of_ne hβ (Ne.symm hn)
  have hright : 0 < (4 * β - 1) * (β + 2) / 9 :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num)
  linarith

def quadratic (t : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((z - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 - (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2) /
    (2 * (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)))

theorem quadratic_denominator_ne_zero (t : ℝ) :
    2 * (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
  apply mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
  intro h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  norm_num at him

theorem quadratic_at_i (t : ℝ) : quadratic t Complex.I = 0 := by
  simp [quadratic]

theorem quadratic_injective_on_upper_half_plane (t : ℝ) :
    Set.InjOn (quadratic t) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} := by
  intro z hz w hw heq
  have hd := quadratic_denominator_ne_zero t
  have hnum :
      (z - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 - (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 =
      (w - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 - (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun v : ℂ => v * (2 * (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)))) heq
    simpa [quadratic, hd] using hh
  have hprod : (z - w) * (z + w - 2 * (t : ℂ)) = 0 := by
    calc
      (z - w) * (z + w - 2 * (t : ℂ)) =
          ((z - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 - (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2) -
          ((w - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2 - (Complex.I - (t : ℂ)) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hnum
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hzw | hsum
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzw
  · have him := congrArg Complex.im hsum
    have hsumim : z.im + w.im = 0 := by simpa using him
    change 0 < z.im at hz
    change 0 < w.im at hw
    linarith

end AffineTransport
